core_meaning.short_meaning: Criterion, that which distinguishes truth from falsehood
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Furqaan corresponds to the Arabic form فُرْقان (Arabic root ف ر ق (f-r-q); فُرْقان (Furqān)). Its core sense is criterion, that which distinguishes truth from falsehood. Furqaan (فُرْقان) means 'that which distinguishes truth from falsehood, the criterion', from the root ف ر ق (f-r-q) 'to separate, distinguish'. It is a QUR'ANIC WORD — al-Furqān is a name of the Qur'an itself (Surah 25) — and the root sense appears in the Qur'an; its use as a personal given name is a separate naming practice. The source gloss 'divine guidance' is a loose paraphrase of 'criterion'.
